responsibility: Implements the public RVV intrinsic header presented to users. Besides small inline CSR access helpers for vector CSRs, its key role is to validate that vector support is enabled and to trigger GCC’s built-in registration of RVV types and intrinsics via `#pragma riscv intrinsic "vector"`, making it the user-facing bridge from source code to the compiler’s internal RVV builtin machinery rather than a header that manually declares all intrinsics.
